section: Important policies and programmes of the Government of Andhra Pradesh - welfare and social security
subsections: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: The ‘Super Six’ in Andhra Pradesh refers to which of the following?
o: A group of six centrally sponsored schemes implemented in Andhra Pradesh
A package of six welfare guarantees of the present State Government
Six constitutional guarantees for economically weaker sections
accepted.x: Super Six is the present Andhra Pradesh Government’s package of six welfare guarantees.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact nature of the named package before matching its individual components.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: The delivery of which package was reviewed by the Chief Minister at the 8th Collectors’ Conference held on 12 September 2026?
accepted.x: The Chief Minister reviewed the delivery of the Super Six guarantee package at the 8th Collectors’ Conference on 12 September 2026.
accepted.tq: Match the event with the specific programme and retain the date as the deciding clue.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched under the current Super Six guarantees of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Deepam — Free bus travel for women
Annadata Sukhibhava — Direct financial assistance to farmers
Auto Driver Sevalo — Seasonal relief to marine fishermen
accepted.x: Annadata Sukhibhava provides direct financial assistance to farmers. Stree Shakti concerns free bus travel, Deepam provides LPG cylinders, and Marine Fishing Ban Relief benefits marine fishermen.
accepted.tq: Use beneficiary-benefit matching and eliminate schemes paired with a neighbouring guarantee.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s:
With reference to Talliki Vandanam, consider the following statements:
1. It benefits the mother of every school-going child studying in a government or private school.
2. The assistance is ₹15,000 per child per year.
3. The assistance is calculated per mother irrespective of the number of children.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Talliki Vandanam provides ₹15,000 per school-going child per year to the mother. Unlike Amma Vodi, it is calculated per child, not per mother.
accepted.tq: Separate the closely related per-child and per-mother designs to detect the reversed comparison.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: Talliki Vandanam replaced which earlier scheme?
accepted.x: Talliki Vandanam replaced Jagananna Amma Vodi, which was launched in January 2020.
accepted.tq: Test the old-name to new-name relationship directly.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: Jagananna Amma Vodi, launched in January 2020, provided ₹15,000 annually into the bank account of the mother or recognised guardian of a poor child sent to which level of education?
accepted.x: Amma Vodi provided ₹15,000 annually to the mother or recognised guardian of a poor child attending school or college.
accepted.tq: Read the beneficiary condition precisely instead of narrowing the education level unnecessarily.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: The stated objective of Talliki Vandanam is to reduce schooling costs and thereby improve the
accepted.x: Talliki Vandanam is intended to reduce the cost of schooling and raise the Gross Enrolment Ratio.
accepted.tq: Link the immediate welfare benefit with its stated educational outcome.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the nine pillars of Navaratnalu?
accepted.x: Navaratnalu included Jalayagnam, Pedalandariki Illu, and YSR Aasara/Cheyutha. Stree Shakti is a current Super Six guarantee, not one of the nine Navaratnalu pillars.
accepted.tq: Find the item belonging to the current guarantee package rather than the earlier nine-pillar programme.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s:
Which one of the following combinations correctly represents the nine pillars of Navaratnalu?
1. Rythu Bharosa
2. Fee reimbursement
3. Aarogyasri
4. Jalayagnam
5. Prohibition
6. Amma Vodi
7. Pensions
8. Pedalandariki Illu
9. YSR Aasara/Cheyutha
accepted.x: Navaratnalu comprised all nine listed pillars: Rythu Bharosa, fee reimbursement, Aarogyasri, Jalayagnam, prohibition, Amma Vodi, pensions, Pedalandariki Illu and YSR Aasara/Cheyutha.
accepted.tq: Check the complete named list; the option containing every listed pillar is the correct combination.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: Navaratnalu was associated with which period?
accepted.x: Navaratnalu was the nine-pillar welfare framework associated with the period 2019–2024.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the programme period and the periods of other State initiatives.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: The name ‘Cheyutha’ was first used for a scheme during which period?
accepted.x: The name Cheyutha was first used for a Naidu-era scheme during 1995–2004.
accepted.tq: Use the period attached to the historical name rather than the period of the later YSR scheme.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: Under YSR Aasara, the outstanding bank loans of women’s Self-Help Groups as on 11 April 2019 were repaid in
accepted.x: YSR Aasara repaid the outstanding bank loans of women’s Self-Help Groups as on 11 April 2019 in four instalments.
accepted.tq: Retain the cut-off date and number of instalments as a paired quantitative fact.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: According to the APSES 2024–25 data, YSR Aasara disbursed ₹633.74 crore through DBT to how many SHG members?
accepted.x: APSES 2024–25 recorded ₹633.74 crore transferred through DBT to 69,597 SHG members under YSR Aasara.
accepted.tq: Match the programme with its exact DBT amount and beneficiary count.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the change from YSR Vahana Mitra to Auto Driver Sevalo?
o: The scheme changed from annual assistance to free LPG cylinders.
The annual assistance increased from ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 for owners of self-owned autos.
The beneficiary changed from auto drivers to marine fishermen.
The annual assistance decreased from ₹15,000 to ₹10,000 for all transport workers.
accepted.x: YSR Vahana Mitra provided ₹10,000 annually to self-owned auto or taxi drivers, while the current Auto Driver Sevalo provides ₹15,000 annually to owners of self-owned autos.
accepted.tq: Compare the old and current scheme names by beneficiary and benefit amount.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: Stree Shakti provides free bus travel to which beneficiaries under its stated design?
o: All senior citizens and students in Andhra Pradesh
Women and transgender persons domiciled in Andhra Pradesh
Only women domiciled in the capital region
Only women auto drivers and fishermen
accepted.x: Stree Shakti provides free bus travel for women and transgender persons having Andhra Pradesh domicile.
accepted.tq: Identify the beneficiary category while avoiding the distractor that restricts the scheme to women alone.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: Under Stree Shakti, free travel is available in which APSRTC bus categories?
accepted.x: The stated design of Stree Shakti covers free travel in five APSRTC bus categories.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a specified numerical coverage from the extreme claim that every category is included.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Stree Shakti:
1. It was launched on 15 August 2025.
2. It was later extended to persons with disabilities.
3. Women’s share of bus travel increased from 40 per cent to 65 per cent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: Stree Shakti was launched on 15 August 2025, later extended to persons with disabilities, and women’s share of bus travel rose from 40% to 65%.
accepted.tq: Verify each date, extension and percentage before selecting the complete combination.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: As reported for Stree Shakti, the number of free journeys exceeded
accepted.x: Stree Shakti recorded more than 71 crore free journeys as reported on 13 June 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the reported threshold rather than confusing it with the separate occupancy figure or trip count.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: Deepam-2 was launched in 2024. Which earlier Deepam initiative is distinguished from it by providing LPG connections?
accepted.x: The earlier Deepam, launched in 1999, provided LPG connections, whereas Deepam-2 provides three free LPG cylinders a year.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between similarly named schemes by comparing their launch years and benefit designs.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: Under Annadata Sukhibhava implemented with PM-KISAN, the annual assistance per farmer family is
accepted.x: Annadata Sukhibhava with PM-KISAN provides ₹20,000 per farmer family annually, comprising ₹14,000 from the State and ₹6,000 under PM-KISAN.
accepted.tq: Add the State and PM-KISAN components while avoiding the temptation to select one component alone.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the instalment pattern of Annadata Sukhibhava assistance?
accepted.x: The three instalments under Annadata Sukhibhava are ₹7,000, ₹7,000 and ₹6,000, totalling ₹20,000 annually.
accepted.tq: Check both the order and total of the instalments rather than merely identifying the component amounts.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding Annadata Sukhibhava is correct?
o: It excludes tenant farmers from its coverage.
It includes tenant farmers and has a budget provision of ₹6,600 crore for 2026–27.
It is meant only for marine fishermen during the seasonal ban.
It provides ₹15,000 annually to self-owned auto owners.
accepted.x: Annadata Sukhibhava includes tenant farmers, and the Budget 2026–27 provision mentioned for it is ₹6,600 crore.
accepted.tq: Use the inclusion or exclusion of a beneficiary group and the budget figure to identify the precise statement.
accepted.sec: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

accepted.s: Marine Fishing Ban Relief under the Super Six guarantees provides marine fishermen with
o: Three free LPG cylinders during the seasonal ban
accepted.x: Marine Fishing Ban Relief provides ₹20,000 to marine fishermen during the seasonal fishing ban.
accepted.tq: Match the occupation-specific beneficiary with the exact seasonal relief amount.

accepted.s: The employment guarantee associated with the current Andhra Pradesh welfare package aims to provide
accepted.x: The jobs guarantee aims at 20 lakh jobs in five years through ITI and skill placements.
accepted.tq: Retain the target figure together with its five-year time frame.

accepted.s: The Chief Minister’s stated approach to welfare delivery treats which of the following as the basic unit?
accepted.x: The Chief Minister stated that the family should be the unit for welfare, including family mapping before sanctioning new pensions.
accepted.tq: Apply the policy principle to the administrative action described in the question.

accepted.x: Family mapping is to precede the sanctioning of new pensions.
accepted.tq: Identify the administrative sequence by linking the preparatory action to the welfare decision it supports.

accepted.s: The stated welfare provision of 5 kg of rice is based on
o: 5 kg per adult woman per month
accepted.x: The stated provision is 5 kg of rice per member of the family.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the unit of entitlement—member—from household, woman or child.
